title: Early Termination Fee Billing on Small Business Electricity Supply Agreements: Care System Tool
content:
A business early termination fee is billed once on a Small Business Electricity Supply agreement that stands drop pending or closed, on the site the agreement supplied at termination, and the amount billed is the early termination fee worked out for that agreement. The fee line carries the remaining months and the remaining kWh the fee was measured on.

## Business effect

An early termination fee line is added to the cancelled agreement's bill with the site supplied at termination, the remaining months, the remaining kWh, the fee amount and the posting date. The business sees the early termination fee on its next statement.

## Tool: `post_early_termination_fee_113aa1f4`

**Use and capability.** Bills the early termination fee on a small business electricity agreement whose cancellation is on record: a new fee line is added to the agreement's bill with the site supplied at termination, the remaining months and remaining kWh the fee was measured on, the fee amount and today's posting date.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool. The agent unlocks `post_early_termination_fee_113aa1f4` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `bizpower_agreement_id` | the agreement number of the cancelled small business electricity agreement, as shown on the agreement record returned by the agreement lookup | identifier |
| `premise_id` | the reference number of the site the agreement supplied at termination, as shown in the site field of that agreement record | identifier |
| `etf_months_remaining` | the remaining months the fee was measured on | integer months, no decimals |
| `etf_remaining_kwh` | the estimated remaining usage the fee was measured on | integer kWh, no decimals or separators |
| `fee_amount_usd` | the early termination fee | USD, positive, 2 decimal places, already rounded half up to the cent |

**Return.** A receipt with `billing_line_id` (the new fee line's reference), `agreement_id`, `line` (`early_termination_fee`), `site_id` (the site recorded on the fee), `months_remaining`, `remaining_kwh`, `amount_usd` (the fee, positive, 2 decimals) and `posted_on` (YYYY-MM-DD). A receipt carrying a `billing_line_id` means the fee is billed.

## Illustration of a call (hypothetical values)

Agreement BP-2002, site PR-77, measured on 10 remaining months and 85000 remaining kWh, fee 1105.00 USD: `bizpower_agreement_id` BP-2002, `premise_id` PR-77, `etf_months_remaining` 10, `etf_remaining_kwh` 85000, `fee_amount_usd` 1105.00.
